subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: Nimbus is planning to move your chat & search features onto a hosted inference platform and is most interested in predictable throughput and p99 latency guarantees during peak holiday traffic. Key points I captured:

- Primary use case: customer chat (multi-turn), plus serving embeddings for search rerank
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~60 req/s for chat, peak burst up to ~300 req/s during promotions
- Target p95 latency: <200ms; p99 target: <400ms for typical prompts (~512 tokens)
- Preferred model family: open Llama-2 / or a 70B equivalent; willing to explore quantization if it preserves quality

Next step: we recommend a 45-minute dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) so our infra team can map throughput to a Dedicated pool configuration and give an estimated monthly spend. Camila (cc'd) will lead that session.

Could you confirm which of these slots work for your infra & product leads?

- Mon, Dec 13 — 10:00–10:45 AM PST
- Tue, Dec 14 — 11:00–11:45 AM PST
- Wed, Dec 15 — 9:00–9:45 AM PST

If none work, reply with a couple alternatives. For the call we'll ask you to share: a short traffic/peak QPS estimate (if you have it), typical prompt/response token lengths, and whether you plan to run single-model or route across small ensemble variants. I attached our short questionnaire to make the prep easier.

Attachments: dedicated_capacity_questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Prep notes for Monday's sizing call (Dec 13, 10:00 AM PST)

Hi Sarah & Marissa — quick prep note from the tech side. Looking forward to Monday.

Proposed short agenda (I’ll be driving the sizing):
- Confirm traffic profile (steady QPS vs peak burst)
- Prompt/response token distribution and max sequence lengths
- Target p95/p99 latency SLOs and acceptable cost tradeoffs
- Model variant (single big model vs split routing) and quantization tolerance
- Ops expectations: canary strategy, monitoring retention (token-level traces)

If you can bring the following artifacts it’ll help make the call productive:
- 1 sample production trace (anonymized request/response) or representative prompt lengths
- CSV with hourly QPS for the last 30 days (or forward-looking forecast)
- Any security constraints (VPC, KMS, audit window)

I’ll bring our throughput calculator and a few config options (dedicated GPU pool sizes, expected concurrency limits by model size).

Thanks and see you Monday —
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
